family_name: Polyair Thermo Reflective Products - Polyair Unicell

spec.description:
Bradford Polyair Unicell is an extra heavy duty,
commercial-grade thermo-reflective insulation roll engineered for roofs and
walls in residential, shed, and warehouse applications. Composed of an inner
fire-retardant bubble cell core laminated between two external layers of extra
heavy duty pure aluminum reflective foil, it reflects up to 95% of radiant heat
in summer and retains warmth in winter. When taped and sealed, it functions as a
weather barrier that blocks draughts, dust, and moisture while reducing
condensation on metal cladding.

install:
Roll out Polyair Unicell over roof
purlins or wall girts perpendicular to framing

Allow a nominal 40mm drape
between purlins to create an airspace and manage condensation drainage
Overlap adjoining runs by minimum 50mm to 100mm

Tape all laps and perimeter
joins with 72mm reinforced aluminum foil tape to form a continuous seal

Fix
metal roof or wall sheeting directly through the insulation to purlins

Ensure
insulation drains freely into gutters without ponding
selection_checklist: Confirm application is metal shed, warehouse, or residential roof/wall
Choose roll width (1350mm standard or 1500mm wide)

Verify requirement for
reflective air space (minimum 20mm gap required to achieve thermal rating)
limitations:
Requires an adjacent air gap of at least 20mm to achieve rated
thermal R-values

Not designed as a primary roof cladding; must be protected
by roof sheets
Avoid contact with wet alkaline concrete or mortar

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Polyair Unicell is an extra heavy duty, commercial-grade
thermo-reflective insulation roll composed of a fire-retardant bubble cell core
laminated between dual layers of pure aluminium foil. Designed for residential
sheds, garages, and commercial warehouses, it reflects up to 95% of radiant heat
in summer while reducing condensation on metal surfaces and blocking wind-driven
